controls.label: Composition spread
controls.persistenceMeaning: Normalized radial scale applied to stable authored neighbourhood centres.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes baseX/baseY distance from canvas centre; does not change ID, source order, harmonic field, or z order.
controls.causalTest: At t=0.42, compare 36 and 92; at least one card centre must move while identity order remains equal.

controls.label: Overlap / depth
controls.persistenceMeaning: Authored print scale and proximity pressure inside the fixed neighbourhood composition.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes card width/height and therefore the stable authored overlap graph; base z order and source pixels remain unchanged.
controls.causalTest: At t=0, compare 0 and 80; card dimensions and overlap signature must differ, IDs and z order must match.

controls.label: Drift strength
controls.persistenceMeaning: Amplitude scale for loop-closed local translation and rotational breath.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Scales x/y/rotation offsets only during the micro-current envelope; seam remains exact.
controls.causalTest: At t=0.42, 0 must equal baseline positions and 70 must differ without changing identity order.

controls.label: Focus lift
controls.persistenceMeaning: Maximum physical separation assigned to the temporary focus plane.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes focused card lift only; base position, baseZ, source opacity/filter/blend, and non-focused cards remain unchanged.
controls.causalTest: At a focus-envelope peak, 60 must yield greater lift than 0 while every non-focused card state remains equal.

controls.label: Cycle pace
controls.persistenceMeaning: Base duration used by automatic and directed timeline compilation.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes compiled duration and temporal velocity; normalized geometry at the same normalized phase remains equal.
controls.causalTest: Automatic duration must equal 6000 ms at 6 and 18000 ms at 18; normalized t=0.42 state must remain geometrically equal.
